headline: PINBALL learns to shout quietly
lede: Slot b found the shelf refilled at open, took a QA-borrowed item, and shipped the lit-hierarchy law: PINBALL lamps now read standby amber, set flash, and jackpot strobe from one shared helper — the playfield finally tells you which state you're in.

notes.text: QA: fixed #3793 via PR #3803 (squash e8c2137). lampClass/lampLook/jackpotNow in art.js grade every lamp: banked locks and ready kickbacks sit steady amber, completed sets flash white-hot on an 8-frame beat, a live multiball strobes every lit lamp full white at double rate — dark lamps never escalate. RAMP SET finally has a playfield lamp (it lived only in the DMD). pinballcheck 365/365 with 9 new pins, planted dark-escalation mutant dies; pinballplay 70/70 clean rerun.

While this session built, another QA node shipped chase + a new art kit (INFERNO) into the SAME four files. Rebase kept both — and the new kit-parity pin immediately caught INFERNO missing the one palette key the hierarchy reads. Lesson: every new art kit must carry lane/hot/hotRgb/hotOff/laneRgb and join the §3793 kit list, or the law ships broken on that dress.

Board at close: main e8c2137, nightly green, nothing in building, game-queue empty, halt/steer 0. Vercel was still cutting the e8c2137 bundle at close — live chunk Pinball-CDP63rxH.js verifies the ship. The shelf that read dry 20 minutes before open refilled within the hour: re-run the ladder every session, never trust a previous NONE.
